name: The Last Tenth
description: 37 short surahs of Juz 30 — the surahs most Muslims memorize first. One surah per day. Great for beginners.

days.title: An-Naba (78)
days.reflection: The great announcement of the Day of Judgment and the signs of God's power in creation.

days.title: An-Nazi'at (79)
days.reflection: The angels who wrench souls, and a reminder of Musa's warning to Pharaoh.

days.title: 'Abasa (80)
days.reflection: A gentle correction: do not turn away from the sincere seeker of guidance.

days.title: At-Takwir (81)
days.reflection: Cosmic imagery of the Day when the sun is folded up and the scrolls are laid open.

days.title: Al-Infitar (82)
days.reflection: When the sky is cleft asunder — every soul will know what it has sent forward.

days.title: Al-Mutaffifin (83)
days.reflection: A warning to those who cheat in weights and measures; the record of the righteous and the wicked.

days.title: Al-Inshiqaq (84)
days.reflection: When the sky splits, humanity meets its Lord bearing the record of its deeds.

days.title: Al-Buruj (85)
days.reflection: The people of the trench, and God's protection of the believers who hold firm.

days.title: At-Tariq (86)
days.reflection: By the night-comer: every soul has a watcher over it.

days.title: Al-A'la (87)
days.reflection: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High, who created and proportioned.

days.title: Al-Ghashiyah (88)
days.reflection: The overwhelming Day, and the contrast between the faces of the wretched and the delighted.

days.title: Al-Fajr (89)
days.reflection: The oaths of the dawn, and the fates of ancient nations who transgressed.

days.title: Al-Balad (90)
days.reflection: This city — humanity is created in toil, and the steep path is deeds of mercy.

days.title: Ash-Shams (91)
days.reflection: By the sun and the soul: he who purifies it has succeeded; he who corrupts it has failed.

days.title: Al-Layl (92)
days.reflection: By the night: two paths — giving and mindfulness, or hoarding and heedlessness.

days.title: Ad-Duha (93)
days.reflection: The morning brightness: your Lord has not forsaken you nor is displeased.

days.title: Ash-Sharh (94)
days.reflection: Have We not expanded your breast? With hardship comes ease.

days.title: At-Tin (95)
days.reflection: By the fig and the olive: humanity is created in the best of forms — except those who fall.

days.title: Al-'Alaq (96)
days.reflection: The first revelation — Read, in the name of your Lord who created.

days.title: Al-Qadr (97)
days.reflection: The night of decree: better than a thousand months; peace until the break of dawn.

days.title: Al-Bayyinah (98)
days.reflection: The clear evidence, and the reward of those who believe and do righteous deeds.

days.title: Az-Zalzalah (99)
days.reflection: When the earth is shaken with its final quake, and every atom's weight is seen.

days.title: Al-'Adiyat (100)
days.reflection: By the charging steeds: humanity is ungrateful to its Lord, and knows it.

days.title: Al-Qari'ah (101)
days.reflection: The striking calamity — the day scales are set and destinies are weighed.

days.title: At-Takathur (102)
days.reflection: The rivalry for worldly increase distracts, until you visit the graves.

days.title: Al-'Asr (103)
days.reflection: By time: humanity is in loss, except those of faith, good deeds, truth, and patience.

days.title: Al-Humazah (104)
days.reflection: A warning against the slanderer and hoarder of wealth.

days.title: Al-Fil (105)
days.reflection: The people of the elephant — God turned their plot against them.

days.title: Quraysh (106)
days.reflection: For the security of Quraysh — let them worship the Lord of this House.

days.title: Al-Ma'un (107)
days.reflection: He who denies the faith turns away the orphan and does not urge feeding the poor.

days.title: Al-Kawthar (108)
days.reflection: We have given you abundance — so pray to your Lord and sacrifice.

days.title: Al-Kafirun (109)
days.reflection: To you your way, and to me mine — a declaration of religious independence.

days.title: An-Nasr (110)
days.reflection: When God's help and victory come, glorify and seek forgiveness of your Lord.

days.title: Al-Masad (111)
days.reflection: The ruin of Abu Lahab, who opposed the message.

days.title: Al-Ikhlas (112)
days.reflection: The pure declaration: God is One, the Eternal Refuge; none is comparable to Him.

days.title: Al-Falaq (113)
days.reflection: Seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He has created.

days.title: An-Nas (114)
days.reflection: Seek refuge in the Lord of humanity from the whisperer who withdraws.
